headlines.title: ADB, 韓 성장전망 0.6%P 올려 3.2%

headlines.summary: 김정관 산업통상부 장관이 22일 국회 산업통상중소벤처기업위원회에서 '대한민국과 미합중국 간 전략적투자의 운영 및 관리를 위한 특별법'에 따른 대미투자 사전보고를 하고 있다. /연합뉴스 산업통상부가 대미 투자 프로젝트 1호 사업으로 텍사스주 엔시날 가스복합화력발전소 건설 사업을 보고한 것으로 알려졌다.

headlines.title: 서울 아파트거래 22%가 6억 이하 …정책대출 커트라인에 몰렸다
headlines.summary: 1만709건 거래…전년동기比 11% 급등 6억 초과하면 디딤돌대출 등 못 받아 매수세에 가격↑…“저가 아파트 소멸” 올해 서울에서 거래된 아파트 5채 중 1채 이상이 ‘6억원 이하’인 것으로 나타났다. 전셋값 급등에 대출 문턱마저 높아지자, 정책대출을 받을 수 있는 시세 6억원 이하의 집으로 매수세가 몰린 것으로 풀이된다.

headlines.title: 거래 말랐는데 신고가는 속출 …“ 2022년 급락장과는 다르다 ”
headlines.summary: 서울 아파트 거래량 석달새 62.8% 급감 역대 최고가 이어져…서울 외곽 급속 확산 가격하락 앞서 거래량 감소 과거 사례에도 “공급 부족·대출 제한에 시장 영향 제한적” 서울 아파트 매매 거래가 급감한 가운데, 신고가 거래는 곳곳에서 속출하고 있다. 하지만 시장에선 거래량 감소가 급격한 가격 조정으로 이어지긴 어려울 것으로 내다보고 있다.

headlines.title: 강남 넘어 오금동도 공사비 3.3㎡당 1000만원 육박
headlines.summary: ‘천정부지’ 치솟는 서울 재건축 공사비 송파구 오금현대 평당 962만원 제시 목동4·13단지 등 곳곳서 1000만원 공사비 급등에 분양가 1년새 34% 상승 반포·여의도·압구정 등 한강변 핵심 정비사업지를 넘어 서울 곳곳에서 3.3㎡(평)당 1000만원 안팎의 공사비 사례가 나타나고 있다.

headlines.title: 정부, 국내도입 원유 ‘ 중동산 비중 ’ 절반 이하로 줄인다
headlines.summary: 중동外 수입시 발생 운임차액 지원금 현행 25%서 확대키로 미국·이란 전쟁에 따른 호르무즈 해협 운항 차질로 원유 수급 공급망에 큰 위기를 겪은 정부가 국내 도입 원유의 중동산 비중을 절반 이하로 줄이기로 했다.

headlines.title: 정부, 非중동 원유 수입부과금 환급 확대조치 재시행
headlines.summary: 정부가 중동 정세 불안에 따른 원유 수급 차질에 대응하기 위해 비(非)중동산 원유에 대한 수입부과금 환급 확대 조치를 재시행한다. 정부는 제6차 부담금운용심의위원회를 서면으로 열고 올해 9~12월 한시적으로 다변화 원유 수입부과금 환급 요건을 완화하고 환급 한도도 확대하기로 했다고 24일 밝혔다. 국제유가.

headlines.title: [금융현미경]유가·금리·경기… 추석 전후 韓 환율 향방 최대 변수는
headlines.summary: 유가 및 주요국 통화긴축 따른 달러·엔 등 움직임에 영향 반도체發 수출 호조 지속…환율 상승 제어 요인으로 원·달러 환율이 재차 1350원 선으로 내려앉았다. 유가 흐름이 환율 향방의 핵심 변수로 자리 잡은 상황에서 미·이란 간 긴장 완화 기대감, 사우디아라비아의 원유 수출 확대 기대감 등이 작용하며 유가가 하락한 영향이다.

headlines.title: 인구감소 · 주택거래 둔화 … 8월 이동자 수 53년 만에 최소
headlines.summary: ▲ 서울 아파트 인구 감소 흐름에 주택 거래까지 둔화하면서 8월 국내 이동자 수가 같은 달 기준으로 53년 만에 가장 적었습니다. 국가데이터처가 오늘(23일) 발표한 '8월 국내인구이동 통계'를 보면 지난달 국내 이동자 수는 47만1천명으로 1년 전보다 4.5%(2만2천명) 감소했습니다.

headlines.title: 7월 출생아 2만4천명, 7년 만에 최대 … 연간 누적 17만명 넘어
headlines.summary: '하반기도 반등 흐름'…1∼7월 누적 출생아 증가율 역대 최고 병원 신생아실 [연합뉴스 자료사진] (세종=연합뉴스) 송정은 기자 = 올해 7월 태어난 아기가 7년 만에 가장 많은 수준을 기록했다. 출생아 수 증가 흐름이 이어지며 올해 연간 누적 출생아는 17만명을 넘었다.

headlines.title: [기자수첩] 2022년 소환 한 주택 공급절벽 정쟁
headlines.summary: "(주택가격이 급등한) 단기적 원인으로 보면 2022년, 즉 윤석열 정권이 들어서고 오세훈 시장이 당선된 해부터 허가와 착공 건수가 절반으로 줄었다. 이런 상황에서 부동산 토지거래 허가를 풀어서 특정 지역의 집값이 폭등했다" 이재명 대통령은 최근 기자회견에서 주택가격이 크게 오른 배경을 묻는 말에 전 정권과 야당 출신 현 서울시장의 정책을 탓했다.

key_headlines.title: OECD Raises Korea's 2026 Growth Forecast to 3.7% - Largest Increase Among G20
key_headlines.summary: International organizations including OECD and ADB have significantly raised South Korea's economic growth forecasts, driven by strong semiconductor exports and expected consumer recovery. Korea's growth outlook improved from 2.6% to 3.7%, reflecting bullish semiconductor sector performance.

key_headlines.title: Won-Dollar Exchange Rate Falls to 1,350 Won as Oil Prices Drop
key_headlines.summary: The won-dollar exchange rate declined to 1,350 won levels as oil prices fell due to easing US-Iran tensions and expected Saudi oil export expansion. Oil price movements have become a key variable in determining Korea's currency direction.

key_headlines.title: Seoul Apartment Market Clustered Below 600 Million Won - Policy Loan Cutoff Effect
key_headlines.summary: Over 22% of Seoul apartment transactions occurred at or below 600 million won as buyers concentrate on properties eligible for government policy loans. This represents an 11% surge in transaction volume at this price point compared to the previous year.

key_headlines.title: Korea's Nuclear Power Plants Expand into US Market with 8 Units Planned
key_headlines.summary: South Korea is pursuing construction of 8 nuclear plants in the US as its second major investment project, including 6 Westinghouse AP1000 units and 2 Korean APR1400 units. This marks significant progress in exporting Korean nuclear technology to the American market.

key_headlines.title: Global Bond Market Shock - Treasury Yields Surge Across US, Europe, and France
key_headlines.summary: Global bond markets experienced a shock with government bond yields surging across major developed economies including the US, UK, and France. Market concerns have risen about sustained inflation and potential additional monetary tightening by central banks.

sections.Hot Economy News: International economic institutions have dramatically upgraded South Korea's growth forecasts for 2026 to 3.7%, representing the largest increase among G20 nations, driven by strong semiconductor exports and anticipated consumer recovery. The won-dollar exchange rate has declined to 1,350 won levels as oil prices fell due to easing geopolitical tensions and increased Saudi oil export expectations. Seoul's apartment market shows concentrated demand in the 600 million won and below segment, with over 22% of transactions occurring at this policy-loan eligible price point. South Korea is advancing its nuclear power expansion into the US market with a plan to construct 8 plants, including Korean-designed APR1400 units. Global bond markets experienced significant shocks with treasury yields surging across major economies, raising concerns about persistent inflation pressures.
sections.Macro & Fiscal Policy: September consumer price inflation decreased to 2.9%, down from previous months, partly due to increased fruit supply during the Chuseok holiday and government discount support measures. However, underlying inflation pressures remain strong, with core inflation at 2.8% and October prices expected to rise to around 3% as communication fee base effects and oil price increases continue. National debt exceeding twice the GDP poses a significant policy dilemma, as interest rate increases expose government fiscal vulnerabilities while rate cuts risk currency depreciation and import price inflation. Government authorities are implementing strategic measures including the elimination of upper limits on whistleblower reward payments and establishment of a progressive incentive system to combat expanding illegal activities including smuggling and customs tax evasion.
sections.Financial Markets: Global government bond yields surged across major developed economies including the US, UK, and France, creating market volatility and investor concerns about sustained inflation and additional monetary tightening. US stock indices experienced modest gains despite sharp bond yield increases, with the S&P 500 rising 0.2% as markets focused on the September employment report. The Federal Reserve's September rate hike of 0.25% initiated a new tightening cycle after 3 years and 2 months, with market expectations for further action by December uncertain. Oil prices increased while government bond yields temporarily declined, supporting modest stock market recovery after earlier volatility from bond market shocks.
sections.Industry & Technology: Boston Dynamics is accelerating mass production preparations for its Atlas robot by recruiting supply chain specialists, recognizing that stable procurement of critical components including motors, sensors, batteries, and semiconductors is essential for commercialization. A nuclear deliberation committee has been launched to gather citizen participation in discussions on the role of nuclear power in energy policy. A new memory semiconductor investment ETF combining Korean, US, and Japanese listed companies will be listed on October 7, providing investors with exposure to the sector. South Korean companies unrelated to semiconductors, including Shinsegae and Daedal, have maintained continuous net buying for nine consecutive months, while major airlines have capitalized on recent won strength improvements.
sections.Real Estate: Strong reconstruction project expectations continue driving apartment prices upward, with Bundang apartments seeing approximately 200 million won increases following reconstruction zone designation announcements. Seoul apartment prices have achieved a record-breaking 86-week consecutive increase, the longest sustained appreciation in history. Regional market divergence has widened, with Gangnam areas experiencing significant price declines while Gangbuk districts maintain price stability, breaking the traditional price coupling pattern. Autonomous districts are taking direct management roles in reconstruction and redevelopment projects to accelerate supply, addressing market concerns about declining new apartment supply and tight jeonse (lease) inventory.
sections.International Economy: The Trump administration is pressuring Europe to release strategic petroleum reserves to address rising diesel prices ahead of the November midterm elections, while demanding the US also commit to not imposing unilateral diesel export bans. The Federal Reserve official Cook expressed concerns about AI investment boom potentially becoming an inflation factor in 2027, noting the need to balance economic growth with price stability. Japan's government and central bank face coordination challenges as officials' statements appear to discourage Bank of Japan rate increases, fueling yen weakness amid US pressure. The Trump administration has secured Korea's 200 billion dollar US investment commitment, including participation in the Alaska LNG project, representing significant geopolitical and economic implications for energy markets.
sections.AI & Economy: Google successfully launched a satellite equipped with its own AI chip (TPU) via SpaceX Falcon 9, marking advancement in the emerging competition among tech giants to establish space-based data centers for AI infrastructure. Google and other big tech companies are increasingly competing to develop space data center concepts as rocket launch costs decline and economic viability improves. GC Pharma emphasized AI and data utilization capabilities as new standards for corporate competitiveness, with leadership highlighting the need for all employees to actively leverage these technologies for productivity and efficiency improvements. Cost considerations related to AI infrastructure deployment in space remain significant, though recent advances in launch economics are reducing barriers to space-based computing solutions.
sections.Others: Hyundai Motor's President Munoz stated that the fifth-generation Tucson is expected to achieve record sales, while acknowledging that domestic market performance deterioration in 2026 resulted partly from strike activities and external factors including tariffs, inflation reduction act changes, geopolitical conflicts, and Chinese competition. The government's selection of a Texas gas-fired power plant as the first Korea-US strategic investment project emphasized commercial viability as the core principle, though profitability concerns remain regarding future power demand. The US Trade Representative's 301 clause investigation into overproduction by China and Japan is nearing completion, with possibilities of additional tariffs being imposed on Korean products. Debates continue between industry leaders including Elon Musk and Jensen Huang regarding AI development pace and investment strategies, reflecting broader disagreements about the sustainability of current AI investment momentum.
